title: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote
content:
HIRING!

Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist

Fully Remote

https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm

Role Overview

We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity.

This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.

What You’ll Do

1. Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images.

2. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency.

3. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion.

4. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes based on project requirements.

5. Document creative decisions, style choices, and simple prompt metadata.

6. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.

Contact via the Turing link above.

author: Abbie Cornall
title: Hiring Colorist and Procreate Illustrator
content:
A VERY EXCITING day today! It's RECRUITMENT DAY!

I am looking to HIRE two positions - please message me in the DMs if you are interested! Please tag someone you know may fit the brief for these positions!

I am looking for 2 freelancers.... the work will just be a few hours at first but will definitely grow more and more over time...

1) A COLORIST

I require a colorist who will create a mobile phone video recording of themselves coloring in one of my Viva Chroma Coloring Pages. We will begin with really simple pages and coloring them in glitter. I can send you examples of the types of videos I would require. You will not need to show your face. You will preferably have nice nails or even better if you have decorative nails. You will require a ring light mobile phone holder that points down to your desk from above so that you can record yourself coloring in the coloring page without any video wobble. I will supply the glitter pens for your videos and the coloring pages too.

TO APPLY: please send me a video of you coloring in a very simple page (the simpler the better) - it doesn't have to be glitter pens (unless you already have some) as I will supply you with those - if you are unsure, I can send you an example of the type of video I require to give you an idea of what I am specifically looking for.

2) A PROCREATE ILLUSTRATOR

I require someone creative who is able to use procreate and who is able to HAND FINISH my coloring page designs for me. I can give more details of this if you would like to message me in the DMs.

These will be very very simple bold and easy designs to begin with and will grow in complexity over time.

You will not be required to draw from scratch - I will provide you will all of my coloring pages and you will be required to add a hand drawn finess to the pages provided using PROCREATE.

I would particularly love to work with people who have disadvantages in the workplace environment through things like mental health / autism /ADHD / AuDHD /etc as these are issues very personal to me so I would love to help others who experience the stuggles that these things bring.

If you are interested in either OR EVEN BOTH of these positions then please send me a DM and we can have a chat more specifically about what I am looking for.

You will be required to send me an example of work even if you have never done this before.

You will also be required to send me your proposed fee for this. I require a proposed fee per video and per 5 pages of hand finished illustrations.

Like I say, we will start off small, and build up as we grow trust and as my business grows over the next year.

Contact via Facebook DM.
